note: Henry County TN publishes no countywide zoning service. The City of Paris zoning map is a web viewer (Zoning App, paris.maps.arcgis.com); its only queryable layer is Parcels_2023 (services8.arcgis.com/s2Id7xxzQUYwu04I), which carries no zoning field. Henry County's TN_County_Parcel_Map Henry_Parcels layer has no zoning field either. The county's ArcGIS Online items named Henry County Zoning (osmyvTbXDC07yFxn HenryCountyZoning, HenryZoningLayer) are Henry County, Ohio, and Zoning (Henry) is Henry County, Illinois. No public queryable zoning district polygons were found for Henry County or Paris.
